# RESH AI — Full Architecture & Operational Reference (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
RESH AI is an enterprise AI implementation partner that builds deterministic, production-ready AI systems tailored to real business workflows. Unlike generic wrappers or experimental chatbots, RESH AI engineers custom multi-agent meshes, sub-800ms conversational voice telephonics, and automated CRM pipelines that directly eliminate operational bottlenecks and deliver verifiable ROI.

## Architecture & Technical Infrastructure

### Voice AI Engine
- **End-to-End Latency:** < 800ms between user speech completion and synthesized audio output.
- **Interruption Handling:** Duplex audio streaming with continuous voice activity detection (VAD).
- **Telephony Connectors:** SIP trunking, WebRTC, Twilio, and Telnyx integration.
- **Calendar & CRM Actions:** Native hooks into Google Calendar, Cal.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho during live calls.

### Lead & Pipeline Automation
- **Lead Capture:** Instant web, voice, and API ingress.
- **Enrichment:** Automated firmographic and intent scoring.
- **Execution:** Automated multi-touch sequences across email, SMS, and WhatsApp with conditional branching based on prospect engagement.

### Support & Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)
- **Vector Storage:** Hybrid semantic search with dense vector embeddings and keyword BM25 retrieval.
- **Data Governance:** Automated redaction of PII (Personally Identifiable Information) before retrieval.
- **Human Escalation:** Intelligent sentiment scoring and automated ticket routing with summarized transcripts.

### Multi-Agent Mesh
- **Orchestration:** Directed acyclic graph (DAG) execution with deterministic state machines and fallback retries.
- **Deployment:** Containerized worker agents running in isolated private VPCs (AWS ECS/EKS or Azure Container Apps).
- **Monitoring:** Real-time telemetry tracking invocation latency, token usage, error rates, and task completion.

## Security, Governance, and SLA
- **Zero-Training Guarantee:** Client proprietary data and conversation logs are explicitly quarantined and never ingested into base model training sets.
- **Encryption:** AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit.
- **Compliance:** SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA-compliant operational architecture patterns.
- **Uptime SLA:** 99.9% availability backed by commercial Master Services Agreements.
- **Code Ownership:** 100% intellectual property ownership transferred to client upon project completion.

## Engagement Model & Pricing
- **Starter Pilot:** Focused automation blueprint or single voice agent pilot, typically delivered in 14 to 21 days.
- **AI Growth Plan:** Multi-workflow orchestration, bidirectional CRM synchronization, and team onboarding.
- **Enterprise Scale:** Custom multi-agent mesh, dedicated VPC isolation, bespoke model fine-tuning, and 24/7 SLA support.
